capabilities: Highlight and underline selected text with four Markdown colors
Explain selections in an AI tutor sidebar with follow-up context
Read selections or the whole note aloud with Web Speech API voices
Save explanations as standalone notes or append them to the source note
Create vocabulary and terminology cards with source links and a status property
extras: Bring-your-own-key plugin: AI requests may incur charges from the configured provider. Highlights, voice reading, and existing cards work without an AI connection; the key is stored in Obsidian's SecretStorage, not in plugin data. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn selected text into an AI explanation, read-aloud audio, and durable vocabulary or terminology cards in one reading workflow.

relations.evidence: OpenAI Responses API, or Chat Completions compatible for another provider.

requires.name: OpenAI or compatible provider API key

summary: Reading companion that highlights selections, explains them through an AI tutor sidebar, reads English aloud, and saves explanations or vocabulary cards.
